items.title: Humana, UnitedHealth trim Medicare Advantage on rising costs
items.summary: Yahoo Finance Senior Columnist Kerry Hannon explains that major health insurers like Humana (HUM) and UnitedHealth Group (UNH) are dropping hundreds of thousands of Medicare Advantage members to protect profit margins as rising utilization drives up costs.

items.title: Humana Is Dropping Plans That Cover 600,000 Medicare Members in 2027. The Letters Arrive in September.
items.summary: A Humana termination letter looks like bad news, but it quietly unlocks a set of rights most members never knew they had, and those rights expire on a clock most people never see coming.

items.title: Do Wall Street Analysts Like Humana Stock?
items.summary: Humana has outperformed the broader market over the past year, and analysts are moderately optimistic about the stock’s prospects.

items.title: The Signs Before UnitedHealth Stock Ran Were In Its Own Exit Plan
items.summary: Management had named the plan exits, the Medicare margin target and the repricing date before the run began.

items.title: CVS Health Stock's Next Leg Sits In Aetna's Unfinished Margin Repair
items.summary: Management has raised its full-year earnings outlook twice, and the segment doing most of the lifting is still short of its own target margin.

items.title: Can Humana Improve Caregiver Retention With HealthStream Deal?
items.summary: HUM's HealthStream deal backs 1,000 caregiver scholarships and new tools to improve recruitment and retention in Indiana.

items.title: CVRx Eyes Barostim Growth as Coverage Gains and BENEFIT-HF Trial Launches
items.summary: CVRx (NASDAQ:CVRX) outlined its efforts to expand adoption of its Barostim therapy for heart failure patients, emphasizing sales-force execution, payer coverage progress and a large post-market clinical trial during Canaccord Genuity’s 46th Annual Growth Conference.
